{"filePath": "/tmp/check_actions.sh", "content": "#!/bin/zsh
export GH_PAGER=cat
repos=(
  actions/checkout
  dorny/paths-filter
  voidzero-dev/setup-vp
  actions/cache
  CodSpeedHQ/action
  codecov/codecov-action
  actions/upload-artifact
  github/codeql-action
  actions/configure-pages
  actions/download-artifact
  actions/upload-pages-artifact
  actions/deploy-pages
  actions/setup-node
  pnpm/setup
  changesets/action
  actions/attest-build-provenance
  ossf/scorecard-action
)
for repo in "${repos[@]}"; do
  tag=$(gh api repos/$repo/releases/latest --jq '.tag_name' 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z "$tag" ]]; then
    tag=$(gh api repos/$repo/tags --jq '.[0].name' 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  sha=$(gh api repos/$repo/git/refs/tags/$tag --jq '.object.sha' 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z "$sha" ]]; then
    # annotated tag - object.sha points to tag object, need to resolve
    tagobj=$(gh api repos/$repo/git/refs/tags/$tag --jq '.object.sha' 2>/dev/null)
    sha=$(gh api repos/$repo/git/tags/$tagobj --jq '.object.sha' 2>/dev/null)
  fi
  echo "$repo $tag $sha"
done
"}

{"content": "#!/bin/zsh
export GH_PAGER=cat

resolve_tag() {
  local repo=$1 tag=$2
  local obj sha type
  obj=$(gh api repos/$repo/git/refs/tags/$tag --jq '.object' 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z "$obj" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR resolving ref for $repo@$tag"
    return 1
  fi
  sha=$(echo "$obj" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['sha'])")
  type=$(echo "$obj" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['type'])")
  while [[ "$type" == "tag" ]]; do
    obj=$(gh api repos/$repo/git/tags/$sha --jq '.object')
    sha=$(echo "$obj" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['sha'])")
    type=$(echo "$obj" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['type'])")
  done
  echo "$repo@$tag -> $sha"
}
